description: This file defines the public API for the coredump pseudo-device driver in Zephyr OS, including structures, function pointer types, and inline functions for managing memory regions and callbacks related to core dump generation.

methods.name: coredump_device_register_memory
methods.description: Registers a memory region to be included in core dump.

methods.name: coredump_device_unregister_memory
methods.description: Unregisters a memory region from core dump.

methods.name: coredump_device_register_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback to be invoked during core dump.
